description: Free car tools and open data for driving in Germany, by Spiking Labs. Every tool is a static page whose inputs live in the URL.

mcp.description: Read-only MCP server with the same data as tools: official consumption per model, the German E-Auto grant and electric vs fuel cost over the years, side-by-side comparison and rankings of models, safety, environment and breakdown ratings, recalls and used-car check, recall statistics, fuel, charging and electricity prices, new registrations and public chargers. Add it as a custom connector in Claude or any MCP client.

tools.name: buying_electric
tools.title: Buying an electric car in Germany
tools.description: Entry page for EV buyers: the E-Auto grant for an income and children, energy cost per 100 km of a typical electric car at home and public prices against a petrol car at this week's prices, public charging in numbers, the most registered electric models last month and recent high-voltage battery recalls, each linking to the full tool.

parameters.income: taxable household income in € a year

tools.name: car_profile
tools.title: My cars: one page per car model
tools.description: Everything Allo Cars knows about one car model: official WLTP consumption, CO2 and power (EEA catalog), cost per 100 km at today's German fuel price or charging prices, EU Safety Gate recalls that name the model and match its first registration year, new registrations in Germany (KBA), Euro NCAP and Green NCAP stars and ADAC breakdowns per 1,000 cars by year (linked to the source), where the model stands in the rankings and similar cars to compare. People can keep several cars on their device; a link opens any model.

parameters.car: vehicle catalog id from https://cars.allo.land/data/vehicle-catalog/de/models.json (id field), e.g. volvo-ex30, vw-golf-petrol, vw-golf-diesel
parameters.year: year of first registration, narrows recalls to the build window (optional)

tools.name: ev_grant
tools.title: German E-Auto grant 2026
tools.description: How much of Germany's 2026 E-Auto grant (E-Auto-Förderung, applied for at BAFA) a household gets for a new electric car or plug-in hybrid: 1,500 to 6,000 € by taxable household income and children under 18, whether a plug-in hybrid qualifies (at most 60 g CO2/km or at least 80 km electric range), the deadline to apply and the official table. The rules are in grant.js.

parameters.drive: bev (fully electric) or phev (plug-in hybrid or range extender)
parameters.income: taxable household income in € a year
parameters.car: vehicle catalog id of a plug-in hybrid, e.g. vw-tiguan-phev-petrol
parameters.range: plug-in hybrid electric range in km

tools.name: compare_cars
tools.title: Compare car models side by side
tools.description: Up to four car models side by side: official WLTP consumption, CO2, electric range, power, mass and power per tonne (EEA catalog), cost per 100 km and per year at this week's German fuel price or charging prices, new registrations in Germany in the last 12 months and the latest rank (KBA), EU Safety Gate recalls that name each model, Euro NCAP and Green NCAP stars, and ADAC breakdowns per 1,000 cars. Rows that are the same can be hidden; the best value per row is marked.

parameters.cars: comma-separated vehicle catalog ids (id field of https://cars.allo.land/data/vehicle-catalog/de/models.json), 2 to 4
parameters.km: kilometres per year for the yearly cost (default 15000)
parameters.same: 1 hides rows where every car has the same value
parameters.best: 0 turns off marking the best value

tools.name: car_rankings
tools.title: Car rankings for Germany
tools.description: Ranked lists of car models from official data: best sellers over 12 months, the latest month's top 20 with the change on a year before, electric best sellers, the most efficient electric cars (WLTP kWh/100 km), the cheapest cars to run per 100 km at this week's German prices, and brands with the fewest Safety Gate recalls per 100,000 new cars. Rows open the model page or go into the comparison.

parameters.list: sellers, month, electric, efficient, cheapest or recalls
parameters.fuel: cheapest only: electric, petrol, diesel or phev-petrol

tools.name: ev_charging_cost
tools.title: EV charging cost per 100 km
tools.description: Cost per 100 km of an electric car at any price per kWh, and the break-even electricity price against Germany's most registered petrol and diesel cars (or your own fuel car). Also the total cost over 4 to 8 years with purchase price, E-Auto grant and vehicle tax, and when the electric car pays for itself.

tools.name: charging_price_archive
tools.title: Charging price archive
tools.description: Ad-hoc public charging prices in Germany collected every hour: median, 10th and 90th percentile per day and per source.

tools.name: car_recalls
tools.title: Car recalls and used-car check
tools.description: Official recalls for a car, new or used: EU Safety Gate motor vehicle alerts since 2019 (Germany's KBA reports every German vehicle recall there) and US NHTSA campaigns. Pick brand, model and year of first registration to see the recalls whose build window covers the car, with what to ask the seller or a garage, a battery check for used electric cars (high-voltage battery recalls, how much of the maker's battery warranty is left, battery questions, warranty terms by brand), and statistics per year, per component and per brand normalised by German new car registrations. Updated daily. Link: ?brand=<slug>&model=<name>&year=<yyyy>; the older ?model=<slug> also works.

parameters.model: model name as Safety Gate writes it, e.g. ID.4 or Golf (letters and digits only are compared), or a slug from https://cars.allo.land/data/recalls/eu/models.json such as volvo-ex30
parameters.year: year the car was first registered, e.g. 2021; recalls whose production dates touch that year or the year before are shown
parameters.km: kilometres on the clock, for the battery warranty check (optional)

tools.name: cheapest_charging_time
tools.title: Cheapest time to charge
tools.description: Cheapest 1 to 8 hour window to charge at home in Germany today and tomorrow, from day-ahead exchange prices (SMARD). Timing only saves money on a dynamic tariff; on a fixed price every hour costs the same. Link parameters: day=0 (today) or 1 (tomorrow), h=hours (1,2,3,4,6,8), kwh=energy added, tariff=dynamic|fixed, grid=grid fee, levies and taxes in EUR/kWh before VAT, markup=supplier markup in EUR/kWh before VAT, fixed=fixed price in EUR/kWh incl. VAT.

tools.name: new_registrations_by_model
tools.title: New car registrations by model
tools.description: Monthly new passenger car registrations in Germany for every brand and model since December 2018 (KBA FZ10), with electric and plug-in hybrid counts, this month's top 20, and the electric wave: the electric share per month with the start of the E-Auto grant marked, electric cars this year against last, and the fastest-growing electric models over the last three months. Open a model with ?model=<slug>, slugs are in models.json.

parameters.model: model slug from models.json, e.g. volvo-ex30

tools.name: charger_map
tools.title: Charger map
tools.description: Every public EV charger in Germany from the Bundesnetzagentur register on a map, filterable by power, plug and payment, with the closest locations to the map centre listed. All settings are URL query parameters. Zoomed in on a place, it also says how easy living there without a wallbox is: public charge points within 1 and 3 km and the nearest fast charger (rules in https://cars.allo.land/chargers/here.js).

parameters.z: zoom 5 to 18, default 6; single chargers and the closest-first list show from 11
parameters.plug: comma separated, any of: type2, ccs, chademo
parameters.only: comma separated, all must hold: 247 (open 24/7), card (pay by card), free, public (not customers only)

tools.name: charger_stats
tools.title: Charging stations in numbers
tools.description: Statistics of the public EV charge points in Germany: rankings of towns (50,000+ people), districts and federal states by charge points, per 100,000 people, fast points per 100,000, battery electric cars per charge point and kW per electric car; charge points by power class, plug and year; top operators. Ranking settings are URL query parameters.

parameters.by: per100k (default), points, fast (fast points per 100,000), bev (electric cars per point, lowest first) or kw (kW per electric car)
parameters.q: text filter on the ranking, e.g. a town or state name
parameters.areas: comma separated regional keys of places whose numbers replace the German totals (added together): state 2 digits (09), district 5 digits (05315), town 12 digits (053150000000); ids are in areas.json

tools.name: vehicle_catalog
tools.title: Official consumption per car model
tools.description: Official WLTP consumption (kWh/100 km at the plug, L/100 km), CO2, electric range, power and mass for every car model and fuel type newly registered in Germany or the EU-27, averaged over the versions sold, with registration counts. From the EEA CO2 monitoring of new cars, refreshed monthly.

tools.name: fuel_prices
tools.title: Fuel prices
tools.description: Weekly national average petrol (Super E5), diesel and LPG prices incl. all taxes since 2005 (EU Weekly Oil Bulletin). Germany by default; every EU country and the EU average under /data/fuel-prices/<region>/.
